props.name: zinc oxide catalyst No. 3 (nitrate solution, ammonia, NaOH)

evidence.quote: (No. 3) 200 grams of zinc oxide were mixed with one liter of water, and sufficient concentrated nitric acid added to dissolve the oxide.
